summary: The note surveys new and existing support groups and counseling services in [Your Local Area], covering mental health, substance abuse, grief, teens, families, and specialized communities. It highlights group launch dates, meeting schedules, and quotes from facilitators and counselors on the value of shared experience in recovery. It frames these services as strengthening both individuals and community ties.
one_line: Overview of local support groups and counseling services for mental health, addiction, grief, teens, families, and specialized needs launched in autumn 2023.
key_facts: Psychologist Johnathan Lowell said on October 15, 2023 that shared experiences and realizing one isn't alone foster healing.
The Mindful Circle, for people with anxiety and depression, held its first meeting on September 3, 2023 and meets every Thursday at the local community center.
Susan Rodriguez is a trained volunteer facilitator of The Mindful Circle, which aims to be a safe space without judgment.
The Bright Horizon Counseling Center is set to open on November 12 and will offer individual therapy and group counseling.
The Phoenix Path, a substance abuse recovery group, launched on September 20, 2023 and meets every Wednesday evening.
Addiction counselor Marcus Brooks said recovery is not a linear path and that strength comes from facing its peaks and valleys together in a group.
The Heartstrings Support Network, focused on grief and loss, began on October 9, 2023 and was spearheaded by facilitator Angela Pearson.
The Next Chapter Teens Group was established on October 5, 2023 to help teenagers with issues from peer pressure to academic stress; youth counselor Melanie Clark is quoted.
The Family Unity network launched on September 25, 2023 and offers weekly family counseling sessions led by therapist Dr. Liam Sun.
The Rainbow Connection serves the LGBTQ+ community, while the Overcomers Support Circle serves survivors of traumatic injuries.
Several new groups are expected to be inaugurated in November in [Your Local Area].
